title: TOOLS-001: The property parsers build `sscanf()` formats with field widths equal to destination buffer sizes, which still leaves room for a terminating NUL beyond the array
description:
TOOLS-001: The property parsers build `sscanf()` formats with field widths equal to destination buffer sizes, which still leaves room for a terminating NUL beyond the array. The remote-server parser also uses `%[^:]:%s` with no widths for `hostname[255]` and `port_str[100]`. Exact-size or long command-line arguments can overflow stack/global buffers before validation. Use bounded widths of `sizeof(buffer) - 1`, check `item_count < MAX_ITEMS` before appending parsed items, and reject overlong fields. Repaired and verified by task 20261024113017-1e1c-fix-fnd-000036-000037; see its verification and independent security reports.
